messages:
Samira: quick weekly note on Nimbus - WoW tokens +20%, QoQ +46%, spend +13% WoW. p95 latency +37ms. Error rate ~5.2% (mostly 429).
Ben: ack. Which routes/keys are largest contributors?
Samira: /v1/generate = ~65% tokens, /v1/rerank = ~17%. Keys: nimbus-main, nimbus-batcher (combined ~80%). Spike window 08:50-09:30 UTC yesterday.
alerts-bot: [ALERT] acct_nimbus - 5m 429 rate = 5.1% (>3.5%). Dashboard: https://dd.example.com/d/nimbus/alerts
Oliver: traces show KV cache hit rate drop during parallel bursts. Client concurrency seems high; many short streams.
Priya: did they change model? QoQ jump suggests a feature rollout.
Samira: yes, they launched "multi-recap" and defaulted some traffic to rdx-3-small three weeks ago.
Ben: short-term mitigations: 1) suggest client concurrency cap to 3; 2) enable prefix cache on /v1/generate; 3) soft-rate-limit non-critical keys; 4) optional model routing to rdx-2-medium for rerank.
Priya: SDK snippet to propose:
```js
// recommended client settings
const client = new RedwoodClient({concurrency:3, batchWindowMs:30, enablePrefixCache:true});
```
Oliver: I'll attach a telemetry slice with tokens by route/hour and top keys. Query used: SELECT api_key, route, SUM(tokens) tokens FROM `redwood.telemetry.events` WHERE account_id='acct_nimbus' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY api_key, route ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;
Samira: action items: Ben -> send concurrency + rate guidance to CSM; Priya -> prep SDK note + short enablement slides; Oliver -> attach telemetry + traces; Samira -> model cost impact scenarios for AE.
Ben: propose 30m enablement: Wed 16:00 UTC or Fri 10:00 UTC. Which works?
Priya: Fri 10:00 UTC fine. I can demo batching, prefix-cache, and model routing.
Samira: I'll book Fri 10:00 UTC, update ticket RED-4321 with the plan, and monitor error rate. If errors exceed 6% before the session we'll escalate. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
